export async function sweep(items, nodes, cache, rows, values, defaults, owner, client, sink, save) {
 let first, second, third, rest;
 for (const [index, item] of items.entries()) {
  const node = nodes[index];
  node.hidden = true;
  (node).style.display = 'none';
  (cache)[item] = item;
  (await getCache())[item] = item;
  (await getBox()).value = item;
  (owner.cache ??= {})[item] = item;
  [first, second] = rows[item];
  ({ value: first } = rows[item]);
  ({ data: [first, second] } = rows[item]);
  ({ value: first = 0 } = rows[item]);
  [first, ...rest] = rows[item];
  client?.notify?.(item);
  const label = node?.dataset?.label;
  const opts = { ...defaults, value: item };
  const copy = [...values, item];
  sink.push(...values);
  const text = `item ${item}`;
  const raw = String.raw`item ${item}`;
  const clean = text.replace(/"/g, '');
  const escaped = text.replace(/["']/g, '');
  await inOrder([item], save, { reason: 'Each write depends on the prior saved state', /* Don't reorder. */ });
  await inOrder([item], save, { reason: 'Each write depends on the prior saved state', normalize: x => x.replace(/"/g, '') });
  const value = label ?? text;
  owner.ready ||= value;
  owner.ready &&= value;
  owner.count++;
  const page = values.slice(0, 4);
  const keys = page.map(x => String(x));
  const unique = new Set(keys);
  const indexed = new Map(keys.map((x, i) => [x, i]));
  try { sink.push(value); } finally { owner.done = true; }
  await save(item);
  (node as HTMLElement).style.display = 'none';
  (cache as Record<string, unknown>)[item] = item;
  node!.hidden = true;
  const typed = { value: item } satisfies { value: unknown };
  const view = <span title={text}>{label}</span>;
  const result: string = String(item);
  @sealed class Local { value = item; }

 }
}

function scanEmptyBodies(groups: string[]): void {
  for (const line of groups) {
    let width = 0;
    for (; width < line.length && line[width] === ' '; width++);
    if (width) break;
  }
  for (const line of groups) {
    for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {}
    if (line.length) return;
  }
}
